column1: # K03 S6 census disposition (Opus, 2026-10-07): every site of dev/l2src_sandbox/l2trans.lm1 that compares a
# head, an atom or a text with a word, with its class (steps/k03-head-census.tsv; functions new since S1
# classified by their contract) and its disposition: word -- a word of the language, which no program binds
# (l2_bind_admit), so the spelling is the one resolution's word at every site and the comparison dispatches
# that word's own contract; inner -- a word inside a resolved receiver's own written contract; lexical --
# an operator, bracket, separator or path form; file -- predef, library and profile texts.
